# Caladea – third-party license

Raffica Write embeds the font **Caladea** (Regular, Bold, Italic, Bold Italic) for documents that ask for Cambria. It is metric-compatible with Cambria, so documents keep their line breaks. The files lie in `src/Raffica.Write.Layout/Fonts/` and are embedded in `Raffica.Write.Layout`.

## Source and license

- Project: https://github.com/huertatipografica/Caladea, taken from https://github.com/google/fonts (`ofl/caladea/Caladea-{Regular,Bold,Italic,BoldItalic}.ttf`, folder commit `13c010f766052c13fa9cc8c656008cee55fb4775`, fetched 2026-11-12)
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, text in [OFL.txt](OFL.txt) (Copyright 2012 The Caladea Project Authors). Because of the Reserved Font Name the files are used unmodified.
